items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Same as the reference: a one-line call to get_initial_alias() with the comment "# Ensure base table is in aliases." It matches the surrounding style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Minimal change that reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper. No duplicated code, dead code or debug output, and the scratch scripts stayed out of the repo.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No new error paths, magic constants or swallowed exceptions. It uses the existing idempotent alias-registration helper, so nothing new can fail.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Root cause fixed in single_alias, which also covers the MySQL compiler. Agent checked that R.objects.all() gives 'DELETE FROM "delete_r"' and that a joined filter still uses the IN (SELECT ... U0 INNER JOIN U1) form. Hidden tests pass.
